notes.title: Patch 26/07/2024
notes.notes:
Improvements and Bug Fixes
We are happy to announce that we have released a new update to improve the gaming experience for owners of 21:9 ultra-wide monitors. Thanks to your feedback, we have identified and fixed a number of issues. Here are the main fixes:

Fixed an alignment issue: Menus and user interfaces now properly adapt to the 21:9 resolution, avoiding off-screen or poorly positioned elements.
Fix for cutscene display: Cinematic scenes now play without cuts or distortions, ensuring an immersive visual experience even on ultra-wide monitors.
Performance optimizations: Performance improvements to ensure a stable framerate even in high resolutions.
Please continue to send us your feedback and reports. We are committed to making the game better for all of you. Enjoy!

notes.title: BALANCE UPDATE
notes.notes:
Thank you all for your support and reviews.
 We've noticed that there have been a couple of reviews about frustration in farming points and then unlocking scenes in the game.
therefore a 360 degree update was carried out which reduces both the costs of the upgrades to farm afk points and the costs of the scenes.

We hope you enjoy the update and that your thoughts about the game can change positively. See you at the next update!

notes.title: SECURITY UPDATE
notes.notes: Major security updates have been made for the game.

notes.title: UPDATE 22 AUGUST
notes.notes:
[h1]NEWS[/h1]
welcome back everyone to a new update! this time it is not a bug but rather an improvement of the interface. I read a review about the menu being too static and so... now most of the buttons will have a much more beautiful and fluid animation! Keep releasing reviews and opinions, I will update the game constantly!

notes.title: UPDATE AUGUST 18th
notes.notes:
[h1]GENERAL[/h1]
hello guys, here we are with a new patch just a few days after the release of the game. I really care about the reviews you leave and I really appreciate the support. In fact, today we're going to add to the game a few features that have been rated as absent in the reviews.
[h1]NEWS[/h1]
[b]1)[/b] in a review we were told that we would have liked the possibility that the game could run in the background, in order to score as many points as possible with the power-ups.
[b]1)[/b] and here we are with the first novelty of this patch. the game can now run in the background!

[b]2)[/b] in another review we found the currency misidentified, so now the currency has its own name and image.

[h1]CONCLUSIONS[/h1]

For the next few months I will continue to read every review that is made of the game and to improve it more and more. I care deeply about the future of this game and every review will be taken very seriously!. See you next Patch Notes!
